mechanics.claim: Gravity Field is a delayed-activation zone, not an instant effect; it applies a slow and separately builds stacks of Heavy Gravity toward a stun, both crowd control and not damage.
mechanics.quote: deploys a gravity field at the target location for {{fd|4.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, it activates to {{tip|slow}} enemies within

mechanics.claim: The knockdown/stun can only trigger once per cast per enemy, even though stacks can continue to accumulate afterward.
mechanics.quote: The knockdown and stun can be triggered only once per cast per enemy.

mechanics.claim: The field persists even if Viktor dies.
mechanics.quote: ''Gravity Field'' will remain active if '''Viktor''' dies.

mechanics.claim: Gravity Field deals no damage itself; it can be blocked by spell shields.
The Magnetize augment adds a 20% slow for 1 second to Viktor's other abilities (excluding Arcane Storm's persistent damage), which is a control effect, not damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Viktor's''' other abilities, excluding ''{{ais|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' persistent damage, {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 20% for 1 second.
